notes: Joint op-ed by Helgi Kjartansson (oddviti) and Stefanía Hákonardóttir (varaoddviti), positions 1 and 2 on T-listinn for the 2026 election, published 8 May 2026. Covers fiscal performance (149M kr surplus 2025), 57% of tax revenue going to children/youth, ~600M kr capex in sports/schools/water/roads, population growth 6.7%/yr, integration of foreign-citizen residents (~40%). Same piece also reposted on Vísir. News articles confirm the T-listinn has its own Facebook page but the FB URL was not located by search.

F-listinn í Eyjafjarðarsveit has a dedicated Facebook page (facebook.com/f.listinn.esveit). No standalone website, op-ed or party-hosted PDF located for the 2026 cycle. kosningasaga and kaffid.is articles only announce the candidate list without policy content; the page may carry áherslur as posts/images for later scrape via Edge CDP.

No 2026-dated stefnuskrá / áherslur located for Framsókn in Grindavík. National party site framsokn.is has not published a Grindavík-specific 2026 page; no dedicated sub-site, op-ed or platform PDF found. Coverage is limited to candidate-list announcements (kosningasaga, RÚV) and unrelated mbl/dv interviews about post-eruption recovery. No dedicated FB page for the Grindavík list located either (only the leader's personal pages and the national Framsókn page).

L-listinn Hrunamannahreppi maintains a dedicated Facebook page (facebook.com/ListiHruni/). No party-hosted website, PDF stefnuskrá or op-ed for the 2026 cycle located via search. The FB page is the best available source — likely contains áherslur as posts/images for later scrape via Edge CDP.

The xd.is/sveitastjornir/hunathing-vestra page is generic and reports only 2022 results (3 reps from 7) — no 2026 áherslur. Örn Arnarson is confirmed as the new D-list leader (2026) per kosningasaga, but no op-ed, party-hosted platform, dedicated sub-site or list-specific Facebook page was located. National Sjálfstæðisflokkur platform is generic, not muni-specific.

The xd.is/sveitastjornir/rangarthing-eystra page is a generic directory of 2022-elected reps with no 2026 áherslur or stefnuskrá. The Sunnlenska article on the D-list 2026 is purely a candidate roster with one quote about 'taking the conversation to residents in coming months' — no policy content. The xd.is page links to a campaign Facebook page (URL not extractable from this fetch). No dedicated sub-site or platform PDF found.

Two lists are running for 2026: E-listi Uppbyggingarlistinn (led by Gunnar Örn Marteinsson) and L-listi Samvinnulistinn. No platform document, dedicated sub-site, op-ed or list-specific Facebook page located for Uppbyggingarlistinn in 2026. Only the muni's own announcement of valid lists is available.

Kaffid.is article (news/feature, 2026) presents Samstaða — new all-female list led by Sigríður Ingibjörg Stefánsdóttir — and quotes their three áherslur: open and professional administration with clear information flow and active resident participation; family-friendly community with strong services and equal opportunities; building a place 'where it is good to live, work and operate' grounded in trust and participation. Vague but the only summarised platform statement available; the list announced these on social media but no FB URL was located by search.

WARNING: do NOT confuse with fjardalistinn.is — that site belongs to Fjarðalistinn í Fjarðabyggð (Neskaupstaður/Reyðarfjörður socialist list) and was last updated Dec 2022; it is NOT for Súðavík. The official sudavik.is announcement and bb.is article on the Súðavík Fjarðarlistinn 2026 only list candidate names (led by Kristján Rúnar Kristjánsson) without platform info. No dedicated 2026 platform, sub-site or Súðavík-specific Facebook page for this list located.

Bæjarins Besta (bb.is) reports on a 'new list' in Árneshreppur for 2026 explicitly framed around the Kaldrananeshreppur merger — the list's stated purpose is to give residents a real alternative for those who feel it is not the right time to merge the municipalities. WebFetch returned 403 so the full article body could not be parsed in this session, but the search-results summary establishes the áherslur. No dedicated website or Facebook page located for the Á-listi; Sigrún Sverrisdóttir's specific role on the list is also not directly confirmed by external sources beyond our own data.
